name: Roborock Saros 10R
summary: A premium robot vacuum and mop that is about 3.1 in tall, low enough for most sofas and bed frames, with the best obstacle avoidance in this guide. The trade-offs are the price and a large, heavy dock.
idealFor: Homes with low sofas and bed frames
Cluttered rooms where obstacle avoidance matters most
pros: About 3.1 in tall: the lowest robot in this guide
Avoided 24 of 24 obstacles in Vacuum Wars tests, the best in this guide
Full-service dock: auto-empty, mop washing, optional removable mops
cons: Large dock (about 15 × 18.7 in, around 25 lb) that needs clear space
Pet hair clogged the dock's emptying tube in TechRadar's test
Vacuuming is loud, according to MacRumors

trust.summary: Three independent hands-on reviews agree it cleans and navigates very well and fits under low furniture. Roborock publishes a 1-year warranty, spare parts support and a contact address, but its product page omits suction and dock dimensions. Safety scores 8/20: no CPSC recalls for Roborock, but we could not verify a UL/ETL listing or FCC ID for this model.

sources.title: BGR: Roborock Saros 10R review
sources.note: José Adorno, Feb 2025, about a month. 3.14 in tall; tangled cables until a no-go zone was set, then reliable avoidance

sources.title: MacRumors: Roborock Saros 10R review
sources.note: Juli Clover, May 2025, two months of daily use; unit provided by Roborock. Thorough on wood and cat hair, rarely stuck; loud vacuuming; heavy dock

sources.title: TechRadar: Roborock Saros 10 vs Saros 10R
sources.note: Derek Adams, May 2025, side-by-side use. 7.98 cm tall, dock 18.7 × 15 × 19.2 in; better mopping than the Saros 10; pet hair clogged the dock tube
